sourceText: Follow-on to B-ec67 (tool-executed evidence-receipts enforcement floor). Add the ergonomics + seatbelt layer so the correct action is the path of least resistance: (1) a first-class verification_run command that resolves an intent and executes its pinned verifier so a caller never hand-authors a pass command; (2) make the stale-evidence refresh re-execute the pinned command and re-issue a real receipt instead of only demoting; (3) a fail-open PreToolUse early-warning guard hook on both hosts; (4) a RED-first smoke. Per docs/evidence-integrity-program-spec.md and docs/step2-evidence-receipts-handoff.md.
normalizedOutcome: A caller proves an executable intent by running lattice verification_run (never authoring a pass command); a stale mechanical receipt whose material changed is re-run and re-issued (not just demoted) when the pinned command still passes; and a mismatched evidence-write command is denied early with a teaching message on both hosts while the B-ec67 handler stays the real floor.
acceptanceClaim: verification_run executes a pinned verifier and stamps a receipt, refresh re-executes-or-leaves-demoted, and a fail-open guard denies a pin-mismatched evidence write on both hosts — all proven by one registered RED-first mutation-killing smoke.
